pin_note: The one place the GUI.Forms pin is written. PIN_GUI_FORMS_MAIN_COMMIT is replaced with the merged GUI.Forms main commit (#483); harness.lock must then equal gui_forms/harness.lock at that commit. Add a platform's digest under cache_sha256 to import its published compiler cache (release build-<revision>); a platform without one compiles from source. SwiftEdit builds the GUI.Forms SDK with its own tools/build_sdk.py --features all; the stx packages (stx_rtf2md among them) come from stx at GUI.Forms' stx.lock commit and install into the same prefix. Its tools forward to template_harness, which prepare_dependencies.py checks out at template_harness/ at the commit harness.lock pins.
